# VivaInsights.Data

```m
VivaInsights.Data(scopeId as text, optional jobName as nullable text, optional jobId as nullable text, optional options as nullable record) as table
```

Import weekly metrics and attribute data from Workplace Analytics.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `scopeId` | `text` | no |
| `jobName` | `nullable text` | yes |
| `jobId` | `nullable text` | yes |
| `options` | `nullable record` | yes |

## Examples (engine metadata — not verified here)

Returns a table with visible attributes and per week metrics for each measured employee in the partition.

```m
VivaInsights.Data("5f142ea5-c08a-eb02-de68-41dccdefb141")
```

Stated result:

```m
#table({"Query1"}, {{"PersonId""}, {"PID"}})
```
